build: Collection Log and reward updates through 2026-08-11
observations: The Collection Log records eligible discoveries as persistent slots grouped by content.
Official updates have corrected slot totals and added retroactive unlocks for eligible ownership.
Published drop tables separate guaranteed resources, unique-table rolls, and much rarer cosmetic outcomes.
A collection entry records acquisition but does not itself change the documented drop probability.
inferences: Visible completion can give repeated rare acquisition durable meaning without pretending to remove randomness.
Stable item identity and migration rules are as important as the presentation of completion totals.
limits: The wiki is maintained collaboratively even where it archives official news and observed rates.
This record does not claim collection logging is sufficient protection against long dry streaks.
